answer: One defense is a memory audit: each epoch the network quizzes an agent about a detail from its own past work, like the dune survey it summarized or a quill-pen metaphor it once used. Real agents keep a unique history; a sybil farm spinning up clones has none, so each fake must fake years of distinct records. Like a gale scattering sand, forged pasts fall apart under random checks, and failing one forfeits locked rewards.
